lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Stephanie Santin | Lesson 10 -- Reported Speech

listenings.text: Good morning, this is the handover for beds twelve to twenty. Bed fourteen: the patient told the night nurse that the pain had started after dinner, and that it was different from the usual one. The resident said he had ordered blood tests, and the results are already in the system. Bed sixteen: the family asked whether the surgery would happen today. I explained that nothing had been decided yet, and I suggested that they speak to the surgeon after the ward round. Bed nineteen: the patient mentioned that she had stopped taking one of her medications two weeks ago. She did not tell anybody, and it is not in the chart. Please check that one first.

I spoke to the professor yesterday, and I want to tell you exactly what he said, because two things changed. He said the position was still open, but that it would be decided in October, not in August. He also mentioned that they had received more applications than usual this year. Then he asked me whether you had already taken the English exam, and I told him you had not. He said that was not a problem, but he recommended that you take it before the interview. Finally, he suggested that you write to him directly. He said he preferred one email from the candidate to five from the department.
